narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of "Control and Coordination." In this video, we'll explore how living organisms, from the smallest bacteria to the largest animals, manage their internal processes and respond to the world around them. Get ready to understand the intricate mechanisms that keep life running smoothly!
